text: All right, [VAR 0100(0000)]?\nIt’s time we filled in our teams a bit—[VAR 0114(0005)]
And I’m here to teach you how!\c\nYou’ll need to catch Pokémon if you’ve got any\nhope of filling in that Pokédex.[VAR 0114(0004)]
Only...look at you, little [VAR 0100(0000)]!\nYou’ve already caught some on your own!\c\nYour mum gave you those Poké Balls, did she?[VAR 0114(0004)]

Every Pokémon has got a type or two, which can
make it good against some opponents but poor
against others.\c
That’s the reason you’ll want to catch different
Pokémon—to cover one another’s weaknesses.\c
Now, let’s all have a champion time as I show you
how it’s done![VAR 0114(0004)]

I’ll give you some more Poké Balls. In return, I’ll
only ask that you catch plenty of Pokémon!\c
The Pokémon around here seem easy to catch.
Almost like they’re itching to join some Trainer’s
team, wouldn’t you say?[VAR 0114(0004)]
The Pokémon on your team will get Exp. Points\nwhen you catch Pokémon, too.[VAR 0114(0005)]

And of course, they get Exp. Points from battle,
so take on the other Trainers you meet along the
path to help your Pokémon thrive.\c
Your team will keep on changing and growing
as you get stronger together, no doubt...
But even I don’t know exactly how yet!
Show your Champion something good, all right?[VAR 0114(0004)]
All right! I’m gonna catch loads of Pokémon.\nThe professor will be shocked when she sees![VAR 0114(0005)]
